//: The worker process (docs/spec-plugin-sdk.md §2 `apps/worker`; SPA-181, mono-11a): the pg-boss host, `runJob`, the heartbeat, the container health command and every job module, lifted out of apps/web/src/worker as a move. It depends on @spaces/core, @spaces/db and pg-boss and never on apps/web as a package — but the job modules still import server modules that have not left apps/web/src/lib (the AI lanes, arrival, documents, import, search, the queue sender), and those cross through the `#web/*` alias declared in tsconfig.json, which the eslint worker zone allows for `lib/` and `test/` only and lists specifier by specifier. The fence narrows as lib/ moves into core; when the list is empty the alias goes. `#/` is deliberately absent, as in packages/db and packages/core: every import here is relative, a real dependency, or a named crossing.
name: @spaces/worker
//dependencies: What the worker process loads at runtime, at apps/web's versions — its own files and the modules it crosses into through `#web/*` alike, because since SPA-183 (mono-13a) the image installs node_modules from `turbo prune @spaces/worker` and nothing else: apps/web runs from its self-contained .output, so a package only apps/web declares is not in the image. The worker's own files reach the AI SDK, readability and linkedom for the URL clip, drizzle and the db handle, Effect, pg-boss and zod; the crossings add the AI providers (@ai-sdk/*, openrouter, ollama), imapflow and mailparser (arrival), pdf-lib (the vision lane), and better-auth and @tanstack/react-start (lib/auth.ts and lib/server/shared.ts). tsx is a devDependency since SPA-185 (mono-13b): the image runs dist/index.mjs and dist/health.mjs, `vite build --ssr` bundles, with plain node; only `pnpm worker` and `pnpm dev` still use tsx. Each crossing's package leaves this list when that module moves into core.
